Name: Oasis sells Cold drinks
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
This mod expands the Oasis (Sandy's) shop to include cold drinks. 
Milk
Goat Milk
JoJa Cola
Cranberry Candy
Ginger Ale
Cactus Juice
Coconut Wine

[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. Please let me know and link the translation to this mod.

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract [b]Oasis sells Cold drinks [/b]into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿


If you like this mod, please endorse it and take a look at my other mods including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30422]Saloon adds drinks[/url].
